figures.required_annotations: time_class=CONTEMPORANEOUS_POLICY_CONTEXT; source=https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20240918a.htm; show hindsight warning/allowed-use boundary from claim registry
figures.required_disclaimer: Context timing must be preserved: retrospective dating and post-anchor shocks were not necessarily known at the earlier policy anchor.

figures.visual_grammar: binary-state support/contrast diagnostic
figures.primary_encodings: state support counts and median trough-month contrast; emphasize equal curve-inversion median trough month
figures.required_annotations: show 8 mechanical / 6 broad episodes and unsupported/insufficient state variation labels
figures.required_disclaimer: Negative small-sample research result; not a timing model, OOS forecast or deployment rule.
figures.prohibited_visual_implications: no signal colors; no composite-score promotion; no curve/NFCI/growth buy-sell labels

figures.visual_grammar: full-sample rho plus leave-one-out stability diagnostic
figures.primary_encodings: one row per frozen predictor with full-sample rho and LOO range/sign-stability flag
figures.required_annotations: full sample must be visually primary; five-episode VIX-common curve diagnostic may only appear as sensitivity
figures.required_disclaimer: Negative small-sample research result; not a timing model, OOS forecast or deployment rule.
figures.prohibited_visual_implications: no cherry-picked five-episode curve headline; no signal colors; no fitted-score visual

figures.visual_grammar: paired PAUSE_START versus FIRST_CUT anchor-to-full-recovery duration comparison
figures.primary_encodings: one paired duration segment per supported asset; months on common duration axis
figures.required_annotations: five fully supported assets only; slower=3, equal=2, faster=0 must be shown as descriptive sample count
figures.required_disclaimer: Historical supported-sample comparison; no causal interpretation and no asset winner.
figures.prohibited_visual_implications: no best/worst ranking; no causal label; no extrapolation to current cycle

figures.visual_grammar: five-block current-state dashboard card
figures.primary_encodings: policy gate; rates/curve; breakevens; stress/credit; real economy/inflation; per-row freshness labels
figures.required_annotations: show 1 hike/25bp/qualification FALSE; show snapshot clock; show observation dates; label FIRST_HIKE historical claims as reference distributions only
figures.required_disclaimer: Current-state description only; not a qualified B08 episode, analog selection, return forecast, bottom date or investment recommendation.
figures.prohibited_visual_implications: no similarity meter; no closest analog; no asset rank; no probability forecast; no green/red trade signal palette
